relief.lifestyle.label: Lifestyle
relief.lifestyle.desc: Internet, devices, books, gym, sports equipment
relief.lifestyle_sports.label: Sports Activities
relief.lifestyle_sports.desc: Additional sports relief on top of lifestyle (cap raised to RM1,000 in YA2026)
relief.ev_green.label: EV Charger / Food Composter / Food Waste Grinder
relief.ev_green.desc: Purchase and installation of qualifying green equipment
relief.ev_green.note: Composter: once every 3 years (YA2025–2027). Grinder: once every 2 years.
relief.cctv.label: Home CCTV System
relief.cctv.desc: Purchase and installation of home CCTV security system
relief.cctv.note: Claimable once every 2 years (YA2026–2027). Keep installation receipt.
relief.tourism.label: Domestic Tourism & Attractions
relief.tourism.desc: Entrance fees to museums, theme parks, national parks, cultural performances
relief.tourism.note: Visit Malaysia Year 2026 — keep attraction receipts.
relief.medical_insurance.label: Medical & Health Insurance
relief.medical_insurance.desc: Premiums for medical or health insurance
relief.life_insurance.label: Life Insurance & EPF Top-up
relief.life_insurance.desc: Life insurance premiums (including children's policies) and voluntary EPF
relief.medical_expenses.label: Medical Expenses
relief.medical_expenses.desc: Dental, vaccinations (all MOH-approved vaccines in YA2026), serious illness treatment
relief.parents_medical.label: Parents' Medical Treatment
relief.parents_medical.desc: Medical expenses for parents (up to RM8,000)
relief.education_self.label: Education Fees (Self)
relief.sspn.label: SSPN Net Savings
relief.sspn.desc: Children's education savings (SSPN-i / SSPN-i Plus) — valid YA2025–2027
relief.home_loan.label: First Home Loan Interest
relief.home_loan.desc: Interest on first home loan for properties ≤RM500k (or RM5,000 for ≤RM750k)
relief.home_loan.note: SPA signed between Jan 2025 – Dec 2027 only.
relief.childcare.label: Childcare & Kindergarten Fees
relief.childcare.desc: Fees for childcare or registered kindergarten (YA2026: expanded to children up to age 12)
relief.prs.label: Private Retirement Scheme (PRS)
relief.prs.desc: Contributions to approved PRS funds (valid until YA2030)
relief.breastfeeding.label: Breastfeeding Equipment
relief.breastfeeding.desc: Female taxpayer only, once every 2 years
relief.zakat.label: Zakat / Fitrah
relief.zakat.desc: Full tax rebate — 1:1 reduction off tax payable
relief.donations.label: Donations to Approved Institutions
